captureMethod: Bounded unauthenticated public HTTP reads through isolated headless Chromium contexts. MCP browser failed before code with an in-use shared profile; local Playwright used to retain raw response fixtures.
sanitization: Public page/API content only; no cookies, browser storage, applicant submissions or credentials. CSP nonce attribute values redacted where present. Structured native selections omit applicant questions.
limitations: Captured fixtures are evidence for offline parser replay, not current production transport or database publication. Static tests with modified records are contract regressions, not live India job evidence.
